note: Original generated aviation images for Airline 96. Neutral liveries, no airline logos. Prompts describe the photographic target for each asset so new aircraft and airports can be added by dropping a data record plus these files.
aircraftExterior: Realistic aviation photograph of a {manufacturer} {model} in a neutral white livery with a single thin cheatline, parked or taxiing at a fictional airport, natural light, no text, no logo, no watermark.
cabin: Realistic interior photograph of a {model} cabin appropriate to that generation, no people, no logos, no readable brand text.
cockpit: Realistic photograph of a {model} cockpit from that generation, no pilot faces, no airline names, no watermark.
maintenance: Realistic hangar photograph of maintenance on a {category} aircraft, no logos, no readable text.
airportAerial: Realistic aerial photograph-style view of a fictional airport in {region}, runways and terminals, no text, no logos.
airportTerminal: Realistic terminal exterior inspired by {city}'s climate and landscape, not a copy of a copyrighted terminal design, no text, no logos.
